node.label: Census 2027
node.summary: India's first digital census and first caste enumeration since Independence.

facts.text: Census 2027 will be India's **first fully digital Census**; door-to-door enumeration begins **1 December** in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa (completed already in Ladakh/snow-bound J&K, HP, Uttarakhand); ~**34 lakh** enumerators will use a phone app, tracked in real time via the **Census Management and Monitoring System (CMMS)**.
facts.plain: Census 2027 will be India's first fully digital Census; door-to-door enumeration begins 1 December in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa (completed already in Ladakh/snow-bound J&K, HP, Uttarakhand); ~34 lakh enumerators will use a phone app, tracked in real time via the Census Management and Monitoring System (CMMS).

facts.text: Census is a Union List subject (**Entry 69**); the governing law is the **Census Act, 1948**.
facts.plain: Census is a Union List subject (Entry 69); the governing law is the Census Act, 1948.

facts.text: Debate: caste data for welfare and reservation, and privacy worries after a trainer linked Aadhaar to citizenship (officials denied it).
facts.plain: Debate: caste data for welfare and reservation, and privacy worries after a trainer linked Aadhaar to citizenship (officials denied it).

facts.text: The **first caste enumeration** in independent India (Q.10C): SC/ST pick from a list, others type their caste; there is no separate OBC column. Aadhaar (Q.37) is optional.
facts.plain: The first caste enumeration in independent India (Q.10C): SC/ST pick from a list, others type their caste; there is no separate OBC column. Aadhaar (Q.37) is optional.

facts.text: Registrar General and Census Commissioner: **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**. Enumerator training framework: **PRAMAN**.
facts.plain: Registrar General and Census Commissioner: Mritunjay Kumar Narayan. Enumerator training framework: PRAMAN.

facts.text: **40 questions**, **13 new** compared with 2011. It is the **first digital census**, filled on a mobile app by about **34 lakh** enumerators.
facts.plain: 40 questions, 13 new compared with 2011. It is the first digital census, filled on a mobile app by about 34 lakh enumerators.

facts.text: Census Phase 2 (**Population Enumeration**) starts **1 Dec 2026** in UP, Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab; the rest of India in **Jan 2027**.
facts.plain: Census Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) starts 1 Dec 2026 in UP, Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab; the rest of India in Jan 2027.

facts.text: Census 2027 Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) notified: **online self-enumeration from 10 Jan 2027**, door-to-door **25 Jan-28 Feb 2027**. In poll-bound **U.P., Goa, Uttarakhand and Punjab**: self-enumeration from 16 Nov 2026 and door-to-door **1 Dec 2026-5 Jan 2027**. Snow-bound areas (Ladakh, parts of J&K, H.P., Uttarakhand) finished by 30 Sept.
facts.plain: Census 2027 Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) notified: online self-enumeration from 10 Jan 2027, door-to-door 25 Jan-28 Feb 2027. In poll-bound U.P., Goa, Uttarakhand and Punjab: self-enumeration from 16 Nov 2026 and door-to-door 1 Dec 2026-5 Jan 2027. Snow-bound areas (Ladakh, parts of J&K, H.P., Uttarakhand) finished by 30 Sept.

facts.text: New Census questions include caste (for non-SC/ST), religion, parents' place and date of birth, number of bank accounts, spouse's name, nationality, digital literacy, place of COVID-19 vaccination, passport and driving licence, and mobile/Aadhaar/voter ID numbers. Caste options include 'does not want to declare' and 'No Caste'.
facts.plain: New Census questions include caste (for non-SC/ST), religion, parents' place and date of birth, number of bank accounts, spouse's name, nationality, digital literacy, place of COVID-19 vaccination, passport and driving licence, and mobile/Aadhaar/voter ID numbers. Caste options include 'does not want to declare' and 'No Caste'.

facts.text: Census Phase 2 (population enumeration) door-to-door starts **1 Dec 2026** in U.P. and three other poll-bound States; the rest of India follows in **Feb 2027**. Each enumeration block has 750-800 people; each household takes 20-25 minutes.
facts.plain: Census Phase 2 (population enumeration) door-to-door starts 1 Dec 2026 in U.P. and three other poll-bound States; the rest of India follows in Feb 2027. Each enumeration block has 750-800 people; each household takes 20-25 minutes.
